grades.quote: The interaction of the memory model with I/O memory, instruction fetches, FENCE.I, page table walks, and SFENCE.VMA is not (yet) formalized.
grades.reason: It only says the memory model does not formalize the interaction with instruction fetches and FENCE.I. It doesn't say whether a local FENCE.I synchronizes other harts' instruction fetches, so it gives only limited context.
It covers committing data FENCE and fence.tso instructions in the operational model. It does not cover FENCE.I or cross-hart instruction-fetch synchronization.
It covers the aq/rl ordering bits on atomic instructions and the data FENCE. It says nothing about FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
